LESSON: WEATHER AND CLIMATE

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Natural and Historic Built Environments
Topic 1.4: Weather and Climate

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Weather and Climate
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why do we experience different climatic conditions in Kenya?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify elements of weather in the environment
2. show main climatic regions in Kenya on a map
3. describe characteristics of the main climatic regions in Kenya

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: identify elements of weather in the environment

Teach
• Today’s focus: identify elements of weather in the environment.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “identify elements of weather in the environment” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "identify elements of weather in the environment" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: show main climatic regions in Kenya on a map

• Listen/read the idea.

• Then do Try this.

Try this

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 3: describe characteristics of the main climatic regions in Kenya

Try this

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: identify elements of weather in the environment
• Model 2: show main climatic regions in Kenya on a map
• Model 3: describe characteristics of the main climatic regions in Kenya

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify elements of weather in the environment
2. Practise: show main climatic regions in Kenya on a map
3. Practise: describe characteristics of the main climatic regions in Kenya

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Weather and Climate.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do we experience different climatic conditions in Kenya?

SECTION: REMEMBER
